packet.verdict_text: **Select option (c): continue with one future B/EXPLORE comparison of training-only scalar value-target normalization in the legal feedback learner against its current raw-target version, with hover retained. Do not select another five-mode mean-execution instance.** The marginally more useful observation is whether a concrete training change improves native feedback performance, rather than whether another learning history repeats a mean-extraction failure that already warrants withholding that execution choice on the observed fits. This is a close choice over **option (b), no further empirical work on the tested mean-execution package**, which is the runner-up. It is not a diagnosis that raw critic targets caused P85, or a prediction that normalization will succeed.
